text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card and tool outputs (13.5% vs 2.7%, z 1.41, 51% low-complexity, 45 records, 19 documented 99215 with 0 below billed vs 17% peers, 3 of 34 data without lab, problems 49%).
